BiblicalUsage: Nehushta is named once, as the mother of Jehoiachin, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem, when her son takes the throne at eighteen. Her son reigns only three months before he is carried to Babylon.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the mother's name is kept for a reason: the king who reigns three months and is carried to Babylon is remembered through his mother, and God records the family behind the throne.
